authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10158 mukha explicitly gives mouth/face mu/muh and retained-kh mukha forms. The simple survey moho/māī and mukh responses preserve these attested contractions or learned/regional forms. Reviewed comparison: bundeli_atarra muh “face” (f_asebugrsqfizc). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6152 danta explicitly gives Maiya/Palula dān, Gawri dant and northwestern dand “tooth”; its addendum includes aspirated Sindhi dandh. The simple dān/dant/dandh survey forms therefore fit this family. Reviewed comparison: Buksa dãnt “teeth” (f_5t5nvmui5lmla). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.

Reviewed comparison: awan niṛe “near” (f_uufqfvkrbejia). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.
